assumptions.assumption: The public site is reachable from the internet.
assumptions.basis: The text calls it the public site and says readers hit the web server.

assumptions.assumption: The web server presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The element is described as the web server serving the public site.

assumptions.assumption: The CMS runs within the hosted network because it runs on the web server, which the text places on that network.
assumptions.basis: The web server runs the CMS, and the web server and database are described as being on the same hosted network.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The database contains accounts and comments, in addition to pages.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN bucket contains public data.
assumptions.basis: The bucket holds images, stylesheets and downloads that readers fetch from the public site.
